positions.name: AsyncRememberContractGuarantees
positions.frame: what does the ratified async remember contract guarantee about latency, durability, and how results reach the agent?
positions.why: All three expressions describe facets of the same just-ratified design: src-1 names the contract and its receipt-in-seconds latency property, src-2 states its two negative guarantees (no blocking, no lost work), and src-3 lays out the concrete dispatch/poll/piggyback mechanism that delivers on those guarantees. Read together they cohere as one contract being both performed (ratified) and unpacked (its invariants and mechanics) — a mild tension between src-1's act of settling the matter and src-2/src-3's ongoing descriptive unpacking of what was settled, which the frame holds rather than resolves.
